ideas.title: The Feeding Our Future fraud scheme: A deeper dive
ideas.description: This story would investigate the details of the Feeding Our Future fraud scheme, including the individuals and organizations involved, and the impact on Minnesota's communities.
questions: Who was involved in the scheme?
What were the consequences for those involved?
ideas.insight: This story could provide a detailed analysis of the fraud scheme and its impact on Minnesota's communities, highlighting the need for greater oversight and accountability in government programs.
